metaTitle: Custom Sublimation Underwear, Robes & Sleepwear | Perfect
metaDescription: Order custom sublimation underwear, robes, and sleepwear with full-color designs. Perfect for corporate gifts or team uniforms.
introHtml: Sublimation printing allows for vibrant, all-over designs that won't crack or peel, making it an ideal decoration method for custom underwear, robes, and sleepwear. Unlike screen printing, sublimation infuses dye into the fabric, resulting in soft-to-the-touch graphics that last through repeated washes. Perfect for hospitality staff uniforms, spa giveaways, or promotional pajama sets, sublimated sleepwear offers unlimited color possibilities and seamless patterns. Choose this option when you need bold, photo-quality artwork on performance fabrics like polyester blends.
heroAltText: Custom sublimation robes and sleepwear with full-color floral patterns displayed on mannequins
